name: GPU Marching Cubes with Histogram Pyramid
aliases: GPU Marching Cubes with HistoPyramid-style Compaction
definition: A GPU-based implementation of the Marching Cubes algorithm that uses a Histogram Pyramid (HP) to efficiently count and locate surface triangles, avoiding the need for atomic operations or sorting during the extraction phase.
summary: GPU Marching Cubes with Histogram Pyramid extracts isosurfaces on the GPU using OpenCL and OpenGL, employing a Histogram Pyramid to count triangles per voxel and compactly store vertex data in a VBO without atomic operations or sorting.
